name: Overhead Surface Orientation
description: Trade-level surface orientation penalty: overhead/ceiling work runs ~20% slower than wall work due to overhead viewing angle, gravity working against the painter, and reach mechanics. Equivalent to multiplying production rate by 0.8 (e.g., wall 1000 SF/hr → ceiling 800 SF/hr). Stored as a TIME multiplier per engine convention (≥1 = slower). Currently still folded into the project-modifier total (modStack.total) at the engine level. Future work: optionally fold into the displayed rate (mirror what TRADE_MATERIAL does) so the modifier column reads cleaner — kept in total for now while orientation-aware rate display is sorted out. Engine: deriveSurfaceOrientation in run-estimate-scenario.js + getFactor lookup against this registry.
